name: 案件間の依存関係の図
prompt:
Use case: text-localization / ui-mockup. LH09-0054 two-project timeline dependency diagram.
Edit ORIGINAL crop image2; image3 enlarges exact fine glyphs, image1 full source supplies context. ORIGINALS PRIMARY for all geometry/proportions, very thin strokes, fine details, visible state and timeline arrangement. Image4 mock SECONDARY Japanese wording; remove its invented mint block and incorrect black connector/solid green endpoint.
Preserve exact original diagram: upper label「利用者体験の調査支援」and SMALL EMPTY white rounded-rectangle bar immediately below, its purple outline adapted to forest green #1F6444. Upper bar stays at original left offset, not fullwidth. Thin vertical current-date line passes near bar's left.
Red fine DOTTED S-shaped dependency from upper bar right edge loops right, runs diagonally down-left through a small red CIRCULAR MINUS marker midway, then loops to left edge of lower bar. Match original curve and endpoint locations, tiny round dots, no thick dashes or arrowheads.
Lower label「利用者の声と行動の集計」above original second SMALL WHITE rounded bar with subtle neutral outline. Its right side has the ORIGINAL cluster of repeated left-facing fine chevrons (first red, remaining gray) terminating in outlined gray DIAMOND. This is not a mint filled bar or solid green dot. Preserve anatomy from enlarged original image3.
Below lower bar exact metadata「目的の共有と整理 +4」, subdued gray Meiryo Regular12/16. Other labels Meiryo Regular14/24, tracking0, no bold heading. Faint neutral vertical timeline gridlines and pure-white canvas. No extra cards/rows/controls, no omitted connector or invented values. Keep compact source proportions with full Japanese labels readable.
reviewNotes: Full S connector, minus, lower chevrons/diamond and Japanese labels restored versus mock; white bars. Red dots and chevron strokes too heavy; current marker line remains purple; type weight/coordinates unproved.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
